_notes: Every behavior an object can list in its logic[]. Each one is src/behaviors/<name>.c/.h. Param types: int, fixed, bool, ticks, button, var, node:<type>, actions, points, choice (one of options), string.

platformer_controller.description: Side-view control: run left/right with the D-pad, jump with a button, climb ladders with up/down. Picks the idle, run, jump, fall and climb animations.

acceleration.description: How fast it speeds up and slows down (pixels per tick, each tick).

jump_height.description: How high a full jump goes (pixels). Letting go of the button early makes a smaller hop.

topdown_controller.description: Top-down control: walk in any direction with the D-pad (no gravity). Faces up, down, left or right and picks the matching idle / walk animations (idle_up, walk_down...).

sword_attack.description: Top-down sword: press the button to swing in the direction the actor faces. It stops while swinging and plays its attack animation. Anything with health inside the blade is hurt and pushed away.

reach.description: How far the blade reaches past the body (pixels).

width.description: How wide the blade's hit area is (pixels).

ticks.description: How long one swing lasts (ticks). Make the attack animation about this long.

cooldown.description: Extra wait after a swing before the next one (ticks).

hits.description: What the blade hurts: enemies only, enemies and props (bushes, pots), or anything with health.

var.description: Only works while this game variable is not 0 (for example, after getting the sword). Empty = always works.

wander.description: Top-down: walks around at random (up, down, left or right), resting now and then. Turns when it bumps into something.

distance.description: Heads back when it gets this many pixels away from where it was placed. 0 = roams anywhere.

locked_door.description: A door that opens when the player walks up to it with a key: uses one key, runs its actions and disappears (its 'die' animation plays as the opening). Give the body physics.solid so it blocks the way.

var.description: Game variable that counts the keys.

consume.description: Use up one key when it opens.

range.description: How close the player must stand (pixels of gap).

patrol.description: Walks left and right on its own, turning around at walls, at ledge edges, or after a set distance.

distance.description: Never walk farther than this many pixels from the start (either side). 0 = only turn at walls and edges.

turn_at_edges.description: Turn around instead of walking off a ledge.

start_left.description: Start walking to the left instead of the right.

chase_player.description: Moves toward the player when the player comes close, and stops when the player is far away. With 'vertical' it also faces up and down (top-down games).

range.description: Starts chasing when the player is this close (pixels).

vertical.description: Also chase up and down (for flying things with no gravity).

follow_path.description: Moves along a list of points (relative to where it was placed), pausing at each point.

points.description: Points to visit, in pixels from the starting position.

mode.description: ping_pong = go back and forth; loop = from the last point travel back to the first and repeat; once = stop at the last point.

solid_platform.description: Other things can stand on it and are carried when it moves.

one_way.description: Only solid from above (you can jump up through it).

health.description: Can be hurt and can die. Blinks and is briefly invincible after a hit. Spikes and falling off the map also hurt. Side view: knocked sideways and falls off the screen when it dies. Top-down (no gravity): pushed straight away from the hit and vanishes in place.

var.description: Game variable that holds the health (shared with the HUD). Empty = private health.

max.description: Starting health when no variable is used.

knockback.description: How far a hit pushes it back (pixels per tick).

spikes.description: Spike tiles (hazard) hurt it. Turn off for monsters that should walk over spikes safely.

damage_on_touch.description: Hurts whoever touches it (if they have health). Does not hurt someone who stomps it from above when it is stompable.

stompable.description: Defeated when the player lands on top of it. The player bounces off.

bounce.description: Upward speed given to the player who stomps it (pixels per tick).

on_stomp.description: What happens when it is stomped.

collectible.description: The player picks it up by touching it: adds to a game variable, plays the 'collect' sound and disappears.

var.description: Game variable to add to. Empty = none.

trigger_zone.description: Runs actions when the player walks into (or out of) its zone.

on_enter.description: What happens when the player enters.

on_exit.description: What happens when the player leaves.

talk.description: When the player stands next to it and presses the button, a dialog opens.

range.description: How close the player must stand (pixels of gap between them, sideways or up/down).

face_player.description: Turn to look at the player.

spawn_particles.description: Emits particles from this object: all the time, when landing, when jumping or while running.

offset_x.description: Emit point, pixels right of the object's origin.

offset_y.description: Emit point, pixels below the object's origin.
